author: nuova.esperienza.1993
name: shader-anima
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Warp stripes style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#04212A, #143943, #7DD4E8, #C7D0D6). Features: film grain, cursor-reactive (repel). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
